items.title: Micron record Q4 and above-consensus outlook; long-term supply commitments $32bn
items.summary: AI/HBM demand remains exceptionally strong; 2027-28 supply-demand expected tighter. Direct read-through strongest to memory/test/equipment chain, but Kioxia NAND exposure is not identical to HBM.

items.title: ラサ工業 台湾に半導体用高純度リン酸新工場、約188億円
